name: SyncDarkroom
subtitle: Edit photos right in your synced folder.
description: SyncDarkroom is an iPad photo editor that works directly on a folder kept in sync (for example with Synctrain/Syncthing). Edits are saved as copies next to the originals, with adjustable settings that sync too.

versions.localizedDescription:
Fix Xcode 26 build; improve release build logs

- CurveEditor: compute the nearest-point distance as CGFloat explicitly.
  Xcode 26's Swift won't implicitly convert Double to CGFloat inside a
  tuple, which broke the release build on GitHub's macos-26 runner.
- build_ipa.sh: keep the full xcodebuild log in build/xcodebuild.log and
  print errors with context on failure.
- Release workflow: actions/checkout@v5 (Node 24) and upload the build
  log as an artifact when the build fails.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

apps.name: SyncDarkroom
apps.subtitle: Photo editor for synced folders
apps.localizedDescription: Browse a Synctrain/Syncthing folder and edit photos non-destructively: light, color, curves, HSL, presets, RAW develop, crop and perspective, masks, healing, Apple Pencil markup and batch edits. Originals are never modified — every edit is a new copy, and its settings sync with the folder.
